university: Dawood University of Engineering and Technology (DUET), Karachi

entries.title: About DUET
entries.answer: Dawood University of Engineering and Technology (DUET) is a public-sector engineering university in Karachi (M.A. Jinnah Road, Karachi-74800). It grew out of Dawood College of Engineering and Technology, whose foundations date to 1962, and was upgraded to a chartered university under a Sindh Government Act (sources give 2012/2013). It is recognised by the Higher Education Commission (HEC). Engineering degrees are four years; Architecture is five years.

entries.title: Academic programs
entries.answer:
Undergraduate programs reported for DUET include:
- BE (Engineering): Chemical, Computer Systems, Electronic, Energy & Environment, Industrial Engineering & Management, Metallurgy & Materials, Petroleum & Gas, Telecommunication.
- B.Arch: Architecture & Planning (5 years).
- BS: Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Cyber Security / Information Security Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Chemistry, Environmental Science.
The programs open in a given session can differ, so please check the current list on the admissions portal. MS and PhD programs are announced separately.

entries.title: Changing program or department
entries.answer: Changing your program or department after admission is governed by DUET's academic rules and usually has conditions (such as merit, seat availability and notified deadlines). I do not have the exact policy, so please ask the admissions office or check the current prospectus before relying on it.

entries.title: Eligibility criteria and minimum percentage
entries.answer:
Minimum marks required in your 2nd-year Intermediate result (HSSC Part II / 12th class, or equivalent):
- Bachelor of Engineering (BE) programs: at least 60%.
- Bachelor of Science (BS) programs: at least 50%.
BE normally needs F.Sc Pre-Engineering (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) or an equivalent such as a relevant DAE. Candidates with foreign or A-Level qualifications need an IBCC equivalence certificate. Guides also mention an upper age limit (reported as about 25 years) and provisional applications for students awaiting results. Meeting the minimum only makes you eligible; selection is by merit (CPN).

entries.title: CPN (merit aggregate)
entries.answer: Merit at DUET is based on the Composite Percentage Number (CPN). Published guides give the weights as: CPN = 10% Matric + 30% Intermediate + 60% Entry Test (for example Matric 85, Inter 75, Test 70 gives 73%). The admissions portal also mentions a deduction for results passed more than one year earlier. Try the CPN Estimator on this page, and confirm the official formula on the admissions portal.

entries.title: Merit lists and closing CPN
entries.answer: DUET publishes a first merit list, a second merit list if seats remain, and a separate self-finance list. In 2025 most programs reportedly closed between about 50% and 62% CPN (for example BS AI near 59%, BE Computer Systems near 62%, BE Electronics near 53%); these are third-party estimates and change every year. Seats include quotas such as Sindh Urban, Sindh Rural, AJK, staff children and overseas candidates, and Sindh domicile is needed for the Urban/Rural quotas.

entries.title: Entry test
entries.answer: Every applicant, including self-finance candidates, has to pass the DUET entry test, which carries the largest share (60%) of the CPN. I do not have a verified syllabus or paper pattern, so please check the roll number slip and the admissions portal for the date, centre and test details.

entries.title: How to apply
entries.answer:
Application steps (as described on the admissions portal):
1) Register / log in on the DUET admissions portal.
2) Fill in the online form with your academic and personal details and choose program preferences.
3) Pay the application/test fee with the bank challan or supported banking app.
4) Print the completed form and send it with the required documents and fee receipt to the Directorate of Admissions before the due date.
5) Download your admit card / roll number slip and appear in the entry test.
6) Check the merit list and complete enrolment on time.
The exact steps can change each session, so follow the current notice on the portal.

entries.title: Required documents
entries.answer: Commonly required: attested copies of Matric and Intermediate mark sheets/certificates (or equivalents), CNIC/B-Form, domicile, recent passport-size photographs and proof of fee payment, plus an IBCC equivalence certificate where applicable. Students awaiting results can usually apply provisionally with a hope certificate. Keep originals ready for verification at enrolment.

entries.title: Deadlines and schedule
entries.answer: Admissions usually run once a year with the entry test and merit lists following a few weeks after applications close. Different websites quote different dates, so I do not guess them. The official schedule is published on the admissions portal and DUET's official pages.

entries.title: Fee structure
entries.answer: Fees depend on the seat category and program. Reported figures (third-party, approximate): application + test fee about Rs. 3,000 (non-refundable); one-time admission fee and refundable security deposit of about Rs. 5,000 each; tuition on merit seats roughly Rs. 32,000 per semester for BE/B.Arch/BS Math/Chemistry/Data Science and roughly Rs. 70,000 for BS CS/AI/Cyber Security/Environmental Science. Self-finance seats are much higher (the official fee page lists Rs. 400,000 and Rs. 600,000 plus taxes depending on program). Fees change every year, so confirm on the Fee Structure page of the admissions portal before paying.

entries.title: Scholarships and financial aid
entries.answer: Support reported for DUET students includes merit scholarships for top performers each semester, HEC need-based scholarships, the Indigenous (government-funded) scholarship program and external programs such as PEEF. Availability and criteria change every session, so check the Scholarships information on the portal or ask the Student Affairs / Admissions office.

entries.title: International students
entries.answer: Overseas / foreign candidates apply through the international admissions section of the portal. They need an academic record with IBCC equivalence, a passport copy and the international admission/security fee (listed in USD, about 250 USD on the portal). A limited number of seats are reserved for overseas candidates.

entries.title: Hostel and facilities
entries.answer: The campus has libraries, laboratories, an auditorium and student facilities, and a shuttle bus service is reported. Hostel places are very limited, so many students arrange private housing. Please confirm current availability with the Student Affairs office.

entries.title: Contact the admissions office
entries.answer: Admissions portal: admissions.duet.edu.pk. Main website: www.duet.edu.pk. Address: M.A. Jinnah Road, Karachi-74800. A public phone listing gives +92 21 9923 1195/96. Please confirm contact details on the official site before calling or couriering documents.
